caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug with a large, ornate handle on its left side. The mug is cylindrical with slightly flared edges at the top and bottom, and the main body is shaded to suggest a smooth, reflective surface, giving it a silvery-gray appearance. The handle is broad with a distinctive scroll design near its base. The composition is centered, with the mug placed against an off-white or lightly toned background that is nearly empty, accentuating the object. The shading captures the metallic texture and curvature of the mug. In the lower left corner, the artist's name "WALTER DORAN" is written in small capital letters. There are no other objects or significant features in the drawing.
title: Silver Mug
